notes.title: THE EXPLORER: Demo 1 Launch!
notes.content:
[p]The moment you've been waiting for... Demo 1 of The Explorer will be releasing October 3rd![/p][p][/p][p]That's the first demo of this game is almost here, where you will be able to play the first two short stages of the game and provide feedback. This is more of a test to see what everyone wants to see from this game, and we hope you're excited. The exact time that the demo will be releasing are the following:[/p][p][/p][p]8:30 AM EST
5:30 AM PST
6:30 AM MDT[/p][p]4:30 AM AKDT[/p][p]7:30 AM CDT[/p][p]9:30 AM ADT[/p][p][/p][p]Also, as a surprise, here's a brand new look at a segment in The Explorer, but it will not be available in Demo 1.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644167/bccc047200e35bc7b12700cf7cf556f167007ee6.jpg"][/img][/p]
